title: locust-load-tester values
description: Values for the locust-load-tester chart. locust.targetHost and one of locustfile.content / locustfile.existingConfigMap are mandatory in practice, but they are validated by the chart's own templates so the failure message can explain how to set them.

global.description: Reserved for values shared with subcharts. Unused by this chart.

mode.description: Topology: standalone runs a single self-contained Locust process, distributed runs a master plus worker.replicaCount workers.

registry.description: Container registry host. Empty pulls from Docker Hub.

repository.description: Image repository without the registry prefix.

tag.description: Image tag. Falls back to Chart.AppVersion when empty. Numeric-looking tags may arrive as a number from --set, so numbers are accepted.

digest.description: Pin by digest (sha256:...). Takes precedence over tag.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets used to pull from a private registry, e.g. [{name: harbor-creds}].

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names and labels.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the fully qualified resource name entirely.

commonLabels.description: Labels added to every rendered object.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every rendered object.

locust.description: Locust run configuration. Every key here maps to an environment variable read by the image entrypoint.

targetHost.description: Target under test, e.g. http://dotnet-8-app:5000. Required; the chart fails at render time when unset.

spawnRate.description: Users started per second until users is reached (--spawn-rate). May be fractional.

runTime.description: Stop after this long, e.g. 5m or 1h30m (--run-time). Empty runs until the pod is deleted.

autostart.description: Serve the web UI but start the test immediately (--autostart). Requires headless: false.

onlySummary.description: Suppress per-interval stats and print only the final summary (--only-summary).

exitCodeOnError.description: Process exit code when any request failed (--exit-code-on-error). 0 makes a Job report success even with failures.

stopTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for tasks to finish on shutdown (--stop-timeout). Empty omits the flag; accepts a number or a numeric string.

tags.description: Only run tasks carrying these @tag names (--tags).

expectWorkers.description: Wait for this many workers before starting (--expect-workers). Empty defaults to worker.replicaCount; accepts a number or a numeric string.

prefix.description: Path prefix for the CSV files. Must be under a writable mount, e.g. /tmp.

fullHistory.description: Also write a full stats history row per interval (--csv-full-history).

htmlReport.description: Write an HTML report to this path on completion (--html). Must be writable, e.g. under /tmp.

waitForHost.description: Poll targetHost before starting so the run does not report connection errors while the target is still rolling out.

timeout.description: Give up (and start anyway) after this many seconds.

expectStatus.description: Require this exact HTTP status. Empty accepts any HTTP response.

loop.description: Restart the run when Locust exits successfully. Only valid with workload.kind: Deployment and a non-empty runTime.

extraPipPackages.description: pip packages installed into /tmp at container start, e.g. [locust-plugins].

extraArgs.description: Extra flags appended verbatim to the locust command line.

locustfile.description: The locustfile and any files mounted alongside it.

name.description: Filename mounted into /config and passed to locust -f.

content.description: Inline locustfile contents. Ignored when existingConfigMap is set.

existingConfigMap.description: Use a ConfigMap you manage yourself instead of rendering one from content.

extraFiles.description: Additional files mounted next to the locustfile, keyed by filename.

workload.description: How the load generator is scheduled.

kind.description: Deployment (long-running), Job (run once and stop), or CronJob (run on a schedule).

backoffLimit.description: Job/CronJob: retries before the run is marked failed.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Job/CronJob: delete finished Jobs after this many seconds. Empty keeps them; accepts a number or a numeric string.

concurrencyPolicy.description: CronJob: what to do when a run is still going at the next scheduled time.

suspend.description: CronJob: pause the schedule without deleting it.

replicaCount.description: Standalone/master replicas. Above 1 in standalone mode runs independent, uncoordinated tests.

worker.description: Worker pool. Only used when mode: distributed.

resources.description: Per-worker resources. Falls back to the top-level resources when empty.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to worker pods only.

podLabels.description: Labels added to worker pods only.

service.description: Service in front of the Locust web UI.

enabled.description: Expose the Locust web UI. Leave false for headless runs.

port.description: Service port for the web UI.

nodePort.description: Fixed node port. Only used when type: NodePort; empty lets Kubernetes allocate one.

ingress.description: Ingress for the Locust web UI. Requires service.enabled.

className.description: ingressClassName. Empty uses the cluster default IngressClass.

hosts.description: Hosts and paths routed to the web UI.

paths.description: Paths routed to the web UI for this host.

tls.description: TLS blocks passed through to the Ingress spec.

serviceAccount.description: ServiceAccount used by the Locust pods. The load generator needs no API access.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount an API token into the pod. Off by default; nothing here talks to the API server.

name.description: Use an existing ServiceAccount. Generated from the fullname when empty.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context, passed through verbatim.

securityContext.description: Container-level security context, passed through verbatim. readOnlyRootFilesystem is why /tmp is an emptyDir.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the Locust container.

tmpDirSizeLimit.description: Size of the emptyDir mounted at /tmp (scratch, CSV/HTML reports, pip packages).

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe. Off by default: a headless run legitimately stops serving anything.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe. Off by default for the same reason as livenessProbe.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every Locust pod.

podLabels.description: Labels added to every Locust pod.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for Locust pods.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period before the pod is killed. Should exceed locust.stopTimeout.

hostAliases.description: Extra /etc/hosts entries, e.g. to pin DNS for the target.

dnsPolicy.description: Pod dnsPolicy. Empty leaves the Kubernetes default (ClusterFirst).

dnsConfig.description: Pod dnsConfig, passed through verbatim. Required when dnsPolicy: None.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the Locust container.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra envFrom sources (ConfigMaps/Secrets) for the Locust container.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes added to the pod.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts added to the Locust container.

initContainers.description: Init containers added to the pod.

sidecars.description: Sidecar containers added to the pod.
